descriptions.claude: The token you minted at https://chimpvibe.dev/join (shown once). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Stored in your Claude Code settings like any `claude mcp add --header` token.
descriptions.cursor: The token you minted at https://chimpvibe.dev/join (shown once). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Set it in Cursor on the plugin's Configure page. Do not paste it into chat.
descriptions.gemini: The token you minted at https://chimpvibe.dev/join (shown once). It is yours alone; it never leaves your machine except as the Authorization header to chimpvibe.dev. Gemini CLI asks for it during install and stores it in the system keychain.
